result.summary: The page looks mostly intact, but there is a layout issue where the feed content is pushed underneath the fixed bottom navigation, leaving the lower restaurant card partially obscured. There’s also some horizontal clipping on the right edge of the category and restaurant carousels, though that may be intentional for scrollable content.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the feed, obscuring the lower restaurant card and making part of the content hard to access.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/inset to the scrollable content so the last visible items are fully above the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The right edge of the category row and the first restaurant carousel are clipped, which makes the last visible chip/card look cut off.
issues.suggestion: If this is not intentional for horizontal scrolling, add edge padding or a clearer scroll affordance so clipped items look less broken.
